_doc: Per-instance schema of WHU-EA-NativeVector v1.0 (one record per tile-clipped feature).

fields.area_map_units: complete-feature area in World Mercator map units (never ground m^2)
fields.bbox_xyxy_px: [x0, y0, x1, y1) of the clipped rasterisation
fields.centroid_px: [x, y] centroid of the clipped rasterisation
fields.clipped_area_px: rasterised area inside the tile window
fields.full_area_px: rasterised area of the complete feature (unclipped)
fields.multipart: more than one outer ring after clipping
fields.n_hole_rings_full: hole rings of the complete feature
fields.n_outer_rings_full: outer rings of the complete feature
fields.tiny_area: clipped area below the historical 50 px threshold (retained, flagged only)
fields.touches_tile_border: clipped rasterisation reaches the tile edge

geometry: full pixel-space rings live in instances/sample_geometry.jsonl and the gitignored per-tile cache
